svg.title: Sentinel architecture
svg.desc: Browsers reach one nginx container, which serves the React app and passes /api and the alert socket to the Spring Boot API. Reports from data providers and from the simulator enter ingestion, which removes identity and publishes to Kafka. The stream processor stores each report in PostgreSQL with PostGIS and adds it to its seven-day window in Redis. The Python detector checks every hour and writes alerts, which a database trigger announces to the API, which pushes them over WebSocket to inspectors. The public API returns district-level figures only.
svg.text: How a symptom report travels from a clinic to an inspector's alert, and what the public sees. All case data is simulated.
